caption: The video showcases a metallic lattice framework assembled from spheres and rods, resting on a white surface with a curved band, a blocky corner at the upper left, and two long rods spanning the open top. A person in a gray sweatshirt holds both hands clustered at the upper-right junction, pinching the node where the long top rods meet the right vertical band. The framework stays fixed during this grip, with no visible deformation or translation. After a sustained hold, the left hand releases that node and travels downward and to the left, first hovering as an open palm before closing around the left lattice block to steady it. Meanwhile the right hand shifts from pinching the joint to cradling the right vertical band from behind, keeping it upright. With the left hand moved away, the top of the right band is now steadied solely by the right hand, unchanged in size or position. The camera and background remain constant.
